import json
from fractions import Fraction

# Givens
grocery_bill = Fraction(40, 1)
fee_rate = Fraction(25, 100)
delivery_fee = Fraction(3, 1)
tip = Fraction(4, 1)

# Subquestions
percent_fee = grocery_bill * fee_rate            # 25% fee on the final bill
after_percent = grocery_bill + percent_fee       # bill plus percentage fee
after_delivery = after_percent + delivery_fee    # plus delivery charge
final_total = after_delivery + tip               # plus tip

def money(x):
    return f"${float(x):.2f}"

result = {
    "final_answer": money(final_total),
    "evidence": {
        "grocery_bill": money(grocery_bill),
        "percent_fee": money(percent_fee),
        "after_percent_fee": money(after_percent),
        "delivery_fee": money(delivery_fee),
        "after_delivery_fee": money(after_delivery),
        "tip": money(tip),
        "final_total": money(final_total),
    },
}

print(json.dumps(result))
